lines.t: Hi friends! I am Rayo! Today we are going on a long, happy journey!
Through the busy city streets I drive! Beep beep, here I come!
Now the green hills! Flowers are dancing in the wind!
Wow, the ocean road! The waves are singing a song!
Vroom vroom! My wheels love this road!
Up the snowy mountain! Everything is white and sparkly!
Night is here and the stars are twinkling! The moon is my lamp!
Look, a picnic place! Time for a yummy snack break!
One last race with my friends! Ready, set, go!
What a perfect journey! Friends make every road happy! Bye bye!
Morning in the city! I am Rayo, and today I will help everyone!
Helping is my favorite job! Let us go!
First, I carry flowers to the garden party!
Then I bring umbrellas to the sunny beach!
Fast but careful! Everyone is counting on me!
Even in the snow, Rayo delivers smiles!
Last stop under the stars! A warm drink for the night guard!
My friends Bella and Rusty helped too!
We did it together! Helping makes hearts happy!
Tomorrow, another big adventure! Bye bye, friends!
Hello friends! I am Bella! Today is the Flower Parade!
I decorated my roof with roses and tulips!
Through the happy town I roll, flowers everywhere!
A rainbow! Red, orange, yellow! My favorite colors!
By the sea, seagulls are singing with me!
Singing and driving, la la la! What a lovely day!
Autumn leaves are falling like golden rain!
Even the snow sparkles like little diamonds!
Back in town, everyone is clapping for the parade!
The Flower Parade was magical! Bye bye, friends!
Howdy! I am Rusty, the friendly tow truck! Today I help the whole town!
First stop, the farm! Farmer Joe's tractor needs a tow!
Pulling strong and steady! Rusty never gives up!
At the beach, a little car is stuck in the sand! I am coming!
Back in town, I fix the street lamp so kids can play!
The farm again! Time to carry hay for the horses!
Sunset at the beach! One more car to help!
Helping all day makes my engine happy!
The town says thank you! Friends are the best treasure!
What a helping day! Bye bye, see you tomorrow!
Hi friends! A little puppy is lost in the park! Let us find him!
First, I look in the city streets! Puppy, where are you?
In the flower meadow, I hear a tiny bark! Over there!
The puppy is chasing butterflies near the beach!
Careful, little puppy! The road is not a playground!
It is getting dark! I will light the way with my headlights!
Bella and Rusty are helping me search!
We found him! He was hiding under a picnic bench!
Now we race home before dinner! The puppy rides with me!
Everyone is safe and happy! Helping feels wonderful! Bye bye!
Hello friends! Today I am taking the singing birds to the music park!
The birds sing even in the snow! La la la!
Under the rainbow, their song sounds like magic!
In the town square, everyone stops to listen!
Autumn leaves dance to the birds' sweet song!
By the sea, the waves clap for the singers!
Music makes every heart happy!
One more song on the way home! Sing with me!
The whole town is singing now!
What a musical day! Bye bye, friends!
Howdy! Big clouds are coming! A storm is on the way!
I help Farmer Joe bring the animals to the barn!
The wind is strong, but Rusty is stronger!
At the beach, I pull the boats to safe ground!
Rain is falling! I check every street in town!
The farm road is muddy! I tow the tractor free!
Almost done! One more friend to help!
The storm is over! Look, a rainbow over the sea!
The town is safe, thanks to teamwork!
Time to rest at the farm! Helping day complete! Bye bye!
